issues.detail: The Hebrew lists three names: אֱלִיאֵל (Eliel), עוֹבֵד (Obed), and יַעֲשִׂיאֵל (Jaasiel). The Chinese renders the third name as 雅細耳 (Yaxi'er), which is a plausible transliteration of יַעֲשִׂיאֵל, but the first name אֱלִיאֵל is rendered as 以列 (Yilie), which is a transliteration of a different name (e.g., אֵלִיאֵל or אֶלְיָאֵל). The Hebrew name אֱלִיאֵל is typically transliterated as 以利以謝 or 以利業, not 以列. This is a name swap/mistranslation of the first name.
